caption: The video captures an outdoor playground scene from a low, front-facing angle. A man in a dark plaid shirt and jeans stands behind a blue bucket-style swing seat, gripping its two metal chains in each raised hand. A young child in a cream distressed sweater, blue jeans and a pendant necklace sits in the seat, head tilted back, gazing upward. Throughout the excerpt the man's grip and the child's body drift downward within the frame, the seat sliding toward the bottom edge as the child's legs leave the shot. The man's torso leans progressively forward over the child, his gaze following her face. The child's expression opens from a neutral upward look into a wide smile, her head tilting less steeply, while the pendant and her seated position remain. The autumn trees, pale building and the empty swing's pole at right stay put, marking the motion as the swing's, not the camera's.
relations: Man's grip on the two chains -> his hands and torso drift downward, leaning progressively forward over the seated child.
Child's body in the blue seat -> it slides toward the bottom edge as her legs leave the frame.
Child's upward gaze -> her expression opens into a wide smile while her head tilts less steeply.
Static trees, building and empty swing pole -> they stay put, marking the drift as the swing's motion, not the camera's.
